Distinct from PI-098 (replicability-overclaim) and PI-186 (pedagogical-displacement-disclaimer-gap). Suggested fix: retire one of the two cousin instances bracketing the canonical sentence. (a) Rewrite XIV.A's 'The opener was not automation. It was a method.' to drop the negate-then-reframe form: 'The opener was a method.' (preferred — the 'was not automation' binary is the more conspicuous slogan a JLE editor would flag as SV register). (b) Rewrite XIV.C's 'rather than constituting that teaching' to drop the cousin: 'The adopted method equips an artifact that supports the professor's live teaching.' (lighter touch, preserves XIV.A framing). Either form lifts density from one-per-130-words to one-per-200-words, restoring the canonical sentence's distinctive weight.
